summary.zh: 本次更新加入无需 Hana 发布签名密钥的传统原始安装包回退，同时强化远程服务器状态评估、局域网连接、附件预览与服务器安装升级的可靠性。
summary.en: This update adds a legacy raw installer fallback when Hana release-signing keys are unavailable, while improving remote server assessment, LAN connectivity, attachment previews, and server install/upgrade reliability.

title.zh: 设置中可查看远程服务器评估

summary.zh: 连接远程服务器后，可在设置中查看基于已验证清单与运行证据的服务器状态与兼容性评估。
summary.en: When connected to a remote server, Settings can show status and compatibility assessment based on verified manifests and runtime evidence.

details.zh: 支持按连接范围协调并保留评估结果
details.en: Assessments are coordinated per connection and retained in the app stores

details.zh: 可检查已安装发行版状态并消费服务器兼容性清单
details.en: Inspects installed release status and consumes server compatibility manifests

sources.title: feat(settings): show remote server assessment
feat(remote): assess server evidence truthfully
feat(release): add server compatibility manifest
feat(server): inspect installed release status

title.zh: 局域网连接与 WebSocket 鉴权更可靠
title.en: More reliable LAN connect and WebSocket auth

summary.zh: 修复新局域网地址因 CSP 无法完成首次校验、以及 WebSocket 握手 403 的问题，连接票据也优先并带回落。
summary.en: Fixes first-time LAN connect blocked by CSP and WebSocket 403 handshakes; connection tickets are preferred with a LAN fallback.

details.zh: 主进程预校验新远程地址，避免渲染进程 CSP 鸡生蛋问题
details.en: Main-process pre-validation for new remote URLs avoids renderer CSP chicken-and-egg failures

details.zh: 局域网 WebSocket 允许使用 query token 完成鉴权
details.en: LAN WebSocket connections may authenticate with query tokens

details.zh: WebSocket 优先使用票据，并支持局域网回退
details.en: WebSocket prefers tickets and can fall back on LAN

sources.title: fix: main-process pre-validation for LAN connect (CSP bootstrapping)
fix: allow query token auth for LAN WebSocket connections
feat(ws): prefer tickets with LAN fallback

title.zh: 修复图片消息回放失败

summary.zh: 已保存的“仅标记”图片回合不再被错误还原成 base64 直传载荷，避免提供商返回 HTTP 400。
summary.en: Persisted marker-only image turns no longer rebuild direct base64 image payloads that providers reject with HTTP 400.

details.zh: 回放时保留文本标记与附件路径，不再合成直传图片体
details.en: Replay keeps text markers and attachment paths without synthesizing direct image bodies

details.zh: 同步加固图片回放相关补丁发布路径
details.en: Hardens the image-replay patch release path

sources.title: fix(replay): stop synthesizing direct image payloads for persisted marker-only turns
fix(replay): harden image replay patch release

title.zh: 远程附件与技能预览更完整
title.en: Better remote attachment and skill previews

summary.zh: 远程会话附件预览可正确保留，并支持由服务器托管的技能预览。
summary.en: Remote session attachment previews are preserved, and server-owned skill previews are supported.

details.zh: 修复远程会话中附件预览丢失的问题
details.en: Keeps attachment previews available in remote sessions

details.zh: 支持服务器侧技能预览展示
details.en: Supports server-owned skill preview display

sources.title: fix: preserve remote session attachment previews
fix(remote): support server-owned skill previews

title.zh: 删除模型后设置会正确保存

summary.zh: 在提供商设置中移除模型后，变更会正确写入并在下次加载时生效。
summary.en: Removing a model in provider settings is saved and still applied after reload.

details.zh: 修复模型删除未持久化的问题
details.en: Fixes model removal not being persisted

sources.title: fix(providers): persist model removal

title.zh: 草稿在远程环境下更稳

summary.zh: 草稿会按远程能力契约回退内存方案，并忽略过期的 hydrate 会话、遵守远程功能退避。
summary.en: Drafts use contract-aware memory fallback, ignore stale hydrate sessions, and honor remote feature backoff.

details.zh: 在远程能力不可用时使用契约感知的内存回退
details.en: Falls back to contract-aware in-memory drafts when remote features are unavailable

details.zh: 避免陈旧 hydrate 会话干扰，并尊重远程退避策略
details.en: Ignores stale hydrate sessions and respects remote backoff

fix(drafts): ignore stale hydrate sessions
fix(drafts): honor remote feature backoff

title.zh: 服务器安装与升级更省心

summary.zh: install-server 支持全新主机引导，并可通过 GitHub 解析最新或指定版本升级，附带校验与发布资产。
summary.en: install-server can bootstrap fresh hosts and resolve latest or pinned upgrades via GitHub, with verification and release assets.

details.zh: 支持按最新稳定版、指定 tag 或本地 metadata 规划升级
details.en: Plan upgrades from latest stable, a pinned tag, or local metadata

details.zh: 发布多平台 server-bundle 与 .sha256 校验文件
details.en: Publishes multi-platform server bundles with .sha256 sidecars

details.zh: 升级默认 dry-run，并校验下载校验和
details.en: Upgrades default to dry-run and verify download checksums

details.zh: 标签钉住的 CLI 引导会检测安装器是否导入共享模块，并在替换 install-server.mjs 前安装同引用状态依赖闭包；历史单文件标签跳过共享下载。
details.en: Tag-pinned CLI bootstrap detects installer shared imports and installs the same-ref status dependency closure before replacing install-server.mjs; historical single-file tags skip the shared fetch.

title.zh: 数据重置前可备份与恢复
title.en: Safer reinit with backup and restore

summary.zh: reinit-data 支持 dry-run 规划、确认后执行、完整状态备份与恢复，并尽量保留运行所需数据。
summary.en: reinit-data supports dry-run planning, confirmed execution, full-state backup/restore, and preserves operational data where needed.

details.en: Create and verify backups before reset; restore when needed

title.zh: 连接与安装过程更安全

summary.zh: 加强连接探测的 SSRF 防护、统一 no-referrer 策略，并避免远程插件 iframe 凭证出现在查询 URL 中。
summary.en: Hardens connect probing against SSRF, applies a no-referrer policy, and keeps remote plugin iframe credentials out of query URLs.

details.zh: 连接探测不自动跟随重定向，降低 SSRF 风险
details.en: Connect probing does not follow redirects, reducing SSRF risk

details.zh: 桌面页与服务端响应使用 Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
details.en: Desktop pages and server responses use Referrer-Policy: no-referrer

details.zh: 远程插件 iframe 不再通过 query 传递凭证
details.en: Remote plugin iframes no longer put credentials in query strings

sources.title: SSRF hardening, referrer policy, safer installer
fix: keep remote plugin iframe credentials out of query URLs

title.zh: 粘贴/上传附件预览更稳定
title.en: More stable paste and upload attachment previews

summary.zh: 临时上传会先落到会话缓存，粘贴预览在首次发送前也会保留，显示附件更不易失效。
summary.en: Temp uploads are materialized into the session cache, and paste previews stay available until first send.

details.zh: 绝对路径上传会复制到会话文件缓存后再登记
details.en: Absolute upload paths are copied into the session-files cache before registration

details.zh: 输入区保留粘贴图片的内联预览字节
details.en: Input area keeps inline preview bytes for pasted images

sources.title: Materialize temp uploads to session cache

title.zh: 工具组文件链接带上会话上下文
title.en: Tool-group file links carry session context

summary.zh: 工具结果里的文件详情链接会附带会话路径与消息位置，打开内部链接时可完整追溯来源。
summary.en: File-detail links in tool results include session path and message location so internal opens resolve with full provenance.

details.zh: 与流式 Markdown 内容块使用同一套 linkContext 传递方式
details.en: Uses the same linkContext threading already used by streaming markdown content

sources.title: feat(desktop): pass session linkContext through ToolGroupBlock file-detail links

title.zh: 缺少 Hana 发布签名密钥时仍可安装
title.en: Installable fallback without Hana release-signing keys

summary.zh: 发布流程会在 Hana 签名材料缺失时生成带明确标记的传统原始桌面安装包，并继续提供带校验和的独立服务器包。
summary.en: When Hana signing material is absent, releases can produce clearly marked legacy raw desktop installers while retaining checksummed standalone server bundles.

details.zh: 原始安装包禁用 OTA、更新列车与修复通道，避免混用已签名发布资产
details.en: Raw packages disable OTA, update trains, and repair paths to prevent mixed signed-release assets

details.zh: 无效或不可读的非空签名材料会直接失败，不会静默降级
details.en: Invalid or unreadable nonblank signing material fails closed instead of silently downgrading

details.zh: 缺少 Apple Developer ID 凭证时，macOS 原始应用包会进行临时签名（并非 Developer ID 签名或公证），并在安装包上传前严格验签
details.en: When Developer ID credentials are absent, raw macOS app bundles are ad-hoc signed—not Developer ID-signed or notarized—and strictly verified before their installers are uploaded

details.zh: 更新摘要生成继续支持提供商无关的 BYOK 配置
details.en: Release digest generation retains provider-neutral BYOK configuration
